instruction: A hillside shrine in full cherry blossom: a vermilion torii gate at the base of stone steps, blossoms drifting down like snow, stone lanterns flanking the path, a small shrine building with curved eaves and a rope bell, a koi pond with petals on the surface, a resting bench, paper fortunes tied to branches, and soft pink canopies over everything.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Cherry Blossom Shrine. A hillside shrine in full cherry blossom: a vermilion torii gate at the base of stone steps, blossoms drifting down like snow, stone lanterns flanking the path, a small shrine building with curved eaves and a rope bell, a koi pond with petals on the surface, a resting bench, paper fortunes tied to branches, and soft pink canopies over everything. Style: spring pastel. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
